rationale: The dashboard is a clinical intervention. PROM scores are collected outcomes; the study does not develop or evaluate a health measure.
The paper gives stated-choice survey guidance for patient-preference research. It does not study health-state valuation or a health measure.
A core outcome set specifies which clinical research outcomes to report. This study assesses adoption and feasibility, not an instrument, measurement method, or valuation method.
The report evaluates surrogate clinical endpoints for HTA with statistical methods. It does not develop or evaluate a health measure or valuation method.
The trial tests whether access to QOL data improves clinical outcomes. It does not develop or evaluate the QOL measure.
The review studies presentation and comprehension of PROM results. It does not develop or evaluate a PROM or health-state valuation method.
